title: The Uttar Pradesh Revenue Code, 2006 (consolidated text)
access_note: Primary law. Chapter V governs maintenance of records and mutation: s.33 (succession – report to the Revenue Inspector of the circle), s.34 (transfer, which expressly includes family settlement – report to the Tahsildar; s.34(2) empowers the State to fix a fee scale), s.35 (mutation on the basis of such reports).

title: Transmission of units on death of a unit holder (Death of Unit Holder)
publisher: Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI)
access_note: Verified page content on 2026-09-05: three cases (surviving joint holder / nominee / legal heir); Forms 1–4 (Form-2 = transmission by surviving joint holder); Bond of Indemnity (Annexure-1), Affidavit-cum-No-Objection (Annexure-2), bank attestation (Annexures 3–4); a 'Transmission Documents Matrix – Ready Reckoner' PDF holds the exact document-by-threshold mapping and is not yet text-verified.

title: IRDA (Protection of Policyholders' Interest) Regulations, 2002
publisher: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India
access_note: Verified 2026-09-05. Reg 8(3): life claim paid or disputed within 30 days of all relevant papers; Reg 8(2): queries/additional documents all at once within 15 days of the claim; investigation (where warranted) completed not later than 6 months from lodging; Reg 8(1)/6(1)(n): the policy states the primary documents; Reg 5: grievance mechanism + Ombudsman communicated with the policy. NOTE: this 2002 regulation has since been consolidated (2017, and later) — confirm the current in-force version before execution.

title: Exit from NPS (withdrawal on death of a subscriber)
publisher: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
access_note: Verified 2026-09-05. Death case: the nodal office/POP initiates the online exit based on documents submitted by the subscriber's claimants (or the claimant submits). Documents: death certificate in original, legal heir certificate wherever applicable, withdrawal form, PRAN card, photo ID, residence proof, cancelled cheque, direct-credit mandate, annuity form. Detailed rules (lump-sum vs annuity by sector, corpus threshold, timelines) are in the PFRDA (Exits and Withdrawals under NPS) Regulations, 2015 — not reproduced on the page.

title: Master Circular on Customer Service in Banks — access to safe deposit lockers / return of articles on death (paras 21.1–21.5)
access_note: Verified 2026-09-05. Nominee/surviving joint hirer: access/return of articles after preparing an inventory. No nominee/survivor: legal-heir route via succession documentation. Inventory of contents is mandatory (Annex IV format). Simplified procedures — do not impose unnecessary documentary burden on nominee/survivor. NOTE: RBI issued revised locker guidelines (2021, effective 2022) — confirm the current locker norms before execution.

title: Unclaimed Deposits and the UDGAM portal (FAQs)
access_note: Verified 2026-09-05. UDGAM ('Unclaimed Deposits-Gateway to Access inforMation') is RBI's centralised portal to SEARCH unclaimed deposits across banks. Search needs name + bank + one of PAN/DL/Voter ID/Passport/DOB (or address). Claims can be made ONLY from the respective bank; each unclaimed account has a UDRN (unique number via CBS). The FAQ gives no deceased/legal-heir-specific claim steps.

title: Floating Rate Savings Bonds, 2020 (Taxable) — FRSB 2020 (T) — Operational Guidelines
access_note: Verified 2026-09-05 (updated 27 Jun 2022). With nomination: nominee's claim recognized under the Government Securities Act 2006; if the bond is unmatured the nominee is substituted as holder and a fresh Certificate of Holding (COH) issued. Without nomination: recognition per ss.7-8 of the GS Act 2006 read with Reg 6 of the GS Regulations 2007; the Receiving Office may call for documents/declarations and require a bond of indemnity; doubtful cases referred to RBI IDMD. No monetary threshold stated. Scope: FRSB 2020 (T); other government securities (RBI Retail Direct dated securities, SGBs) follow related but distinct processes.
